description.zh: 完成关键动作后从一点爆出彩色纸屑飘落，用一次性高能量庆祝"做成了"。 只在里程碑出现：提交成功、任务完成、订阅达成—— 正因为稀有，才有庆祝的分量。
description.en: On completing a key action, a burst of coloured pieces erupts and falls — a one-shot, high-energy celebration. It belongs only to milestones: submission success, task done, subscription reached. Rarity is what gives it weight.

use_when.zh: 里程碑完成（首次发布、支付成功、目标达成）
use_when.en: Milestones — first publish, payment success, goal reached

use_when.zh: 空状态被首次打破、成就解锁
品牌调性允许庆祝的 C 端产品
use_when.en: Consumer products whose brand welcomes celebration

avoid_when.zh: 高频操作（每次保存都撒花即灾难）
avoid_when.en: Frequent actions — confetti on every save is a disaster

avoid_when.zh: 会遮挡关键结果信息的时机
avoid_when.en: Moments where it obscures the result itself

note.zh: 从按钮中心向外抛射，最常用
note.en: Erupts from the button center — the default

note.zh: 左右两门礼炮对射，仪式感更强
note.en: Two cannons firing from both sides — more ceremony

note.zh: 从顶部持续飘落数秒，覆盖感最强
note.en: Drifts down from the top for seconds — maximum coverage

notes.zh: 用绝对定位的若干小块（div 或 canvas 粒子），随机角度、初速、颜色做抛物线下落并旋转， 1～2s 动画结束后立即从 DOM 移除， 防止节点泄漏。 一次性触发，不循环； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为静态成功图标。
notes.en: Spawn absolutely positioned small pieces (divs or canvas particles) with random angle, initial velocity and colour, falling in a parabola while spinning; remove them from the DOM as soon as the 1–2s animation ends to prevent node leaks. Fire once, never loop; respect prefers-reduced-motion with a static success glyph instead.

basic.zh: 给任务完成时刻添加撒花庆祝效果：点击完成后爆出彩色纸屑。
basic.en: Add a confetti celebration to task completion — a burst of colour when the task is done.

design.zh: 完成按钮点击后从按钮中心爆出 30～60 枚纸屑，抛物线下落 1.5s 后消失；颜色取品牌色板；一次性，不循环。
design.en: On completion, 30–60 pieces burst from the button center, fall in parabolas for 1.5s, then vanish; colours come from the brand palette; one-shot, never looping.

implementation.zh: 点击时生成 N 个绝对定位小 div，随机 --dx/--dy/--rot 自定义属性驱动 @keyframes 抛物线 + 旋转，animationend 后 remove()。容器 pointer-events:none + overflow:hidden。reduced-motion 直接显示成功状态。
implementation.en: On click, spawn N absolutely positioned divs with random --dx/--dy/--rot custom properties driving a parabola + spin keyframe; remove() each on animationend. Container gets pointer-events:none and overflow:hidden. Under reduced-motion show the success state directly.

agent.zh:
为项目里程碑时刻添加撒花庆祝动效。

先检查产品调性与触发时机清单，确认撒花是合适的（低频正向）。
要求：
- 30～60 枚纸屑，1～2s 抛物线飘落后清理 DOM
- 一次性触发，颜色用品牌令牌
- 不遮挡结果信息，pointer-events 不拦截点击
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add confetti celebration to the project's milestone moments.

Check brand tone and the trigger list first; confirm confetti fits (low-frequency, positive).
Requirements:
- 30–60 pieces, 1–2s parabola, DOM cleaned up afterwards
- One-shot, brand token colours
- Never obscures results; pointer-events must not block clicks
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
